officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed the two load-bearing git-CLI contracts CAM-90 builds on. (1) Compare-and-swap: `git update-ref <ref> <newvalue> <oldvalue>` updates <ref> to <newvalue> ONLY if its current value matches <oldvalue>; on mismatch no modification is performed (the failure CAS-retry hangs on). (2) `git cat-file --batch` reads object names from stdin one per line and frames each as `<oid> SP <type> SP <size> LF<contents>LF`, enabling the single-subprocess O(1) batch read.

[oracle: bun test asserts a multi-file write lands all files in one commit and a mid-list failure writes none]

The off-main update-ref uses compare-and-swap (git update-ref refs/heads/main <new> <old-expected>); on CAS failure the helper re-reads main's current sha, rebuilds the tree on the new base, and retries up to a bounded number of attempts rather than blind-overwriting.
